title: A door-dispatched worker's log tail after the confirm window goes nowhere
body: The door now streams a worker's output through the wave path's own workerLogSink, but only what its spawn window observes: the green-start probe and the confirmed-dispatch wait, about three minutes. Once the start route answers, no Worker code holds the container, so the hours of harness output a real tick produces are never drained to R2. The wave path covered this with its wait loop; a door-path equivalent needs either a drain on the hourly sweep, a log route the Go orchestrator polls alongside its five-minute keepalive, or both.
